title: Felix and the Border
author: Ansel Iversen
blurb: Elodie Amberdale, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
